note: Independent design concept — not official Curry District material. Dielines indicative; confirm with supplier. QR on stuffer cards is a sample pattern placeholder.

items.title: Handled bag — hero (Bazaar)
items.caption: A truck-art arch around the wordmark turns every carry-out into a moving billboard.

items.title: Handled bag — hero (Royal)
items.caption: Jali and a gold mihrab on midnight make takeout feel like a gift worth carrying.

items.title: Handled bag — front, side & back (Bazaar)
items.caption: Front sells the brand, the back maps the menu "districts", the gusset shouts HOT FOOD INSIDE.

items.title: Handled bag — front, side & back (Royal)
items.caption: Mihrab front, a district directory on the back and a foil "Hot food inside" gusset.

items.title: Bag-seal sticker set (Bazaar)
items.caption: Stamp, 5-step spice scale, write-in "sealed fresh", thank-you, packed-for and a tamper strip — tiny ads on every delivery order.

items.title: Bag-seal sticker set (Royal)
items.caption: Stamp, 5-step spice scale, write-in "sealed fresh", thank-you, packed-for and a tamper strip — tiny ads on every delivery order.

items.title: Delivery seal in use (Bazaar)
items.caption: The District Stamp closes the fold and a tamper strip rides over the top — the first thing in every delivery photo.

items.title: Delivery seal in use (Royal)
items.caption: The District Stamp closes the fold and a tamper strip rides over the top — the first thing in every delivery photo.

items.title: Napkin — folded & unfolded (Bazaar)
items.caption: Two-colour block-print border with a face panel that winks: "For the saucy bits. (we won't tell)".

items.title: Napkin — folded & unfolded (Royal)
items.caption: Gold arcade border, ivory tissue and one quiet line: "For the last drop of gravy."

items.title: Cutlery sleeve & kit (Bazaar)
items.caption: "Dig in. Pro tip: naan is also a spoon." — a stripe-sleeve that sounds like the brand.

items.title: Cutlery sleeve & kit (Royal)
items.caption: "Cutlery, should the naan run out." — an arch-window sleeve with a wink.

items.title: Branded tape (Bazaar)
items.caption: One roll turns any plain stock box or bag into a branded order — the cheapest glow-up in the kit.

items.title: Branded tape (Royal)
items.caption: One roll turns any plain stock box or bag into a branded order — the cheapest glow-up in the kit.

items.title: Bag-stuffer thank-you card 4×6 (Bazaar)
items.caption: Warm thanks up front; on the back a policy-safe review ask (no incentive), a QR placeholder and a little spice wisdom.

items.title: Bag-stuffer thank-you card 4×6 (Royal)
items.caption: Warm thanks up front; on the back a policy-safe review ask (no incentive), a QR placeholder and a little spice wisdom.

items.title: Sauce-packet characters (Bazaar)
items.caption: Mint, Tamarind, Raita and Mango Pickle as a collectible cast — each with its own personality line.

items.title: Sauce-packet characters (Royal)
items.caption: Four jewel-toned sachets with gold line-art inside a mihrab window — elegant, never cute.

items.title: Receipt & bag stamp (Bazaar)
items.caption: A one-colour rubber stamp with staff check-boxes brands receipts and plain stock bags for pennies.

items.title: Receipt & bag stamp (Royal)
items.caption: A one-colour rubber stamp with staff check-boxes brands receipts and plain stock bags for pennies.

items.title: What's in the bag — flat-lay (Bazaar)
items.caption: Bag, seals, napkin, cutlery, stuffer and sauces at true relative scale — one system, nothing generic.

items.title: What's in the bag — flat-lay (Royal)
items.caption: Bag, seals, napkin, cutlery, stuffer and sauces at true relative scale — one system, nothing generic.

items.title: Delivery doorstep (Bazaar)
items.caption: Sealed, stamped and loud on the doormat — the neighbours know exactly where dinner came from.

items.title: Delivery doorstep (Royal)
items.caption: Dusk drop-off: a midnight-and-gold parcel that reads "special occasion" from the street.

items.title: Bazaar vs Royal — side by side
items.caption: Same bag, same system — pick loud-and-joyful or jewel-and-gold; both read as Curry District from across the lot.

items.caption: 13 × 13 in, ¼ fold: the face panel is planned first so the joke always lands on top — indicative, confirm with supplier.
